build.beforeDevCommand: npm run server & npm run dev

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: cid: https:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:3001; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Leoposta — a modern local-first mail client
bundle.longDescription: Local-first mail client with IMAP/SMTP, PGP, offline PWA. Bundles a node backend that runs on a random free localhost port — no conflict with other local apps.
